data.fund_name: Baroda BNP Paribas India Consumption Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme following consumption theme
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to seek long term capital appreciation by investing in equity/equity relatedinstruments of the companies that: 1. are likely to beneﬁt directly or indirectly from the domestic consumption led demand;or 2. are related to selling of products or rendering of services that go directly to the consumer; or 3. have products orservices which have distinct brand identity, thereby enabling choice.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related instruments of companies in the consumption theme: 80% - 100% Other Equity and equity relatedinstruments: 0% - 20% Debt and Money market instruments and/or units of liquid fund :0% - 20% Units issued by REITs &InvITs: 0% - 10%
data.benchmark: Nifty India Consumption Total Return Index (TRI)
data.fund_managers: Mr. Pratish Krishnan and Mr. Himanshu Singh
data.exit_load: If units of the Scheme are redeemed or switched out up to 10% of the units (the limit) within 12 months from the date ofallotment - Nil, If units of the scheme are redeemed or switched out in excess of the limit within 12 months from the date ofallotment - 1% of the applicable NAV; If units of scheme are redeemed or switched out after 12 months from the date ofallotment - Nil.
